source_study: Delbaere et al. (2015), En marge... paysage et biodiversité des accotements des grandes infrastructures de transport de l'eurométropole Lille-Kortrijk-Tournai
source_botany_sampling_note: Botanical plots are located along infrastructure and where possible in surrounding vegetation (matrice); plants surveyed in spring, summer and autumn; exact paired plant-by-plot data not confirmed in public PDF.
raw_study_taxon_by_plot_missing: Need original plot IDs, rail or surrounding matrix status, survey date/season, plot area, species presence and cover, and field survey provenance from original botany team at Conservatoire botanique national de Bailleul
interpretation_limits: These are six railway locations among 24 total infrastructure locations in one original regional research program, not six independent publications or climate regions.
A map legend identifying botanist rail/matrix plots is not evidence of matched source matrices with all plant species in a table.
An unverified local pair count of zero means zero source-certifiable pairs, NOT zero pairs surveyed in the original fieldwork.
Flora narratives are not complete species-by-site incidence matrices; candidate Latin binomials in source text cannot be used to fill taxon absence.
Other highway/canal sites are not same-site nonrail controls for the railway site locations.
Railway source type is not a measured freight or passenger traffic exposure, not a train seed dispersal study.
No raw plot GPS, original full PDF or species-by-plot workbook was redistributed.
